hook: A one-armed princess who trades years of her life for a cursed arm, and the lord most central to the plot.
pick: You like politics, logistics and a demanding calendar.
watch: Ch 12 has only about 32 Turns and ends 10/24; three Paralogues and every Send Supplies quest are due by then. Five recruits need Support 3 by Ch 9: seat them at meals from Ch 4. Hold every cursed item past 10/24 (D-103).
systems: Send Supplies quests (unlock Cataphract, Guardian, Dragoon)
why: Arrives with Guardian, Ranger, Blacksmith, Dragoon, Troubadour and Caladrius from the three earlier routes, plus three paths of Boon discounts for Send Supplies.

team.summary: Two groups. The Fortress holds the enemy phase: Theodora (Guardian) with Ninae and Ultand (Priest, then Guardian) beside her, Tobias and Bonaventure on the next tiles, Sirocco and Sofia behind. The Strike group takes the player phase: Alexandra, Lysander, Loretta and Lilian. Zarcone swings the Hammer in Ch 6 to 7 and Tobias takes it in Ch 10. Loretta and Nydine join late Ch 7, Alexandra, Ultand, Ninae and Noctula on 6/1, Simon and Nuzzuo on 7/1, all near Lv 15. Nine deploy from Ch 8; Nydine, Noctula, Simon and Nuzzuo level on the bench, and Part II fields all 15. Advanced before Part II: Theodora, Sofia, Bonaventure, Tobias (Ch 10), Lilian, Lysander (Ch 11), then Sirocco and Loretta or Ultand (Ch 12 if Lv 35). Diego joins in Ch 12 for Part III only.
gaps: Gambit numbers and deploy slots per Renown are undocumented: picks rest on stat bonuses (wall Def/Dex, casters Mag/Res, healers Res/Lck), not gambit damage.
Mastery pace is undocumented. Every side-trip exit is a condition, not a chapter: if a mastery isn't in by Lv 35, take the Advanced class on time and finish it in Part II.

Support 3 for five recruits by Ch 9 (Loretta, Nydine, Ultand, Ninae, Simon): Support is global, so bank it first with the replay meal loop on a cleared chapter where Theodora is in Dagsion (support-level-guide.md); normal Sundays alone are tight (about 12 to Ch 7).

Join levels are player data: Ch 6 to 8 joins arrive at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class; Ch 9 joins (Simon, Nuzzuo) at Lv 15 or about 25 (open). Noctula joining Ch 8 as a Pugilist with the Claw is a player report ?

Specialty Licenses: Part I uses about 18 (12 main-army classes, 3 side trips, 3 bench exams: Nydine Ch 9, Simon and Nuzzuo Ch 10). Part II Ch 1 to 2 spend the Advanced ones on Simon, Ninae, Nydine, Nuzzuo and anyone Ch 12 missed.

Bench EXP: Ch 8 to 12 seat 9 of the core 11, so the sitter (Tobias in Ch 8 to 9, Ultand or Ninae, Lilian) and the Part II bench level in dungeon parties (5 seats) and the Arena. Aim at Lv 30+ by Ch 12 ?
Only one archer deploys in Part I. Ch 12's flier waves and the Pegasus in Dietrich's and Orchel's Paralogues lean on Lilian (swap her in), Bonaventure's Cutting Gale and Sirocco's magic.
Ch 8 to 9 have no Hammer holder: armor falls to Alexandra's Levin Sword, Theodora's Halberd and both casters.
Unconfirmed: fliers counting as [Cavalry] (Nydine stays on the ground), Noctula's Avo stacking, Nydine's Heavy D under a bane, Balor's gates as obstacles for Unstoppable Force.
Deployment slots (6, then 8, then 9) are the player's report, not a source: check the prep screen each chapter.
fixes: Fortress (enemy phase): Theodora's Royal Resolve on the choke, Ninae and Ultand adjacent (Spirits' Guidance, Patch Up, Pray for Safety), Bonaventure's Sage Advice (Def +3), Tobias on the second tile
Strike (player phase): Alexandra ends next to Loretta, Lilian or Lysander (Silver Maiden); Loretta stays at full HP for Peak Form (Sofia's range-3 heals, Ultand adjacent)
Flex bench for Part II: Nydine (Cataphract, Barge Through), Noctula (dodge bait, Ursa's Right Claw), Simon (second Hammer, Power Spike), Nuzzuo (second bow)
Armor: Zarcone's Hammer (Ch 6 to 7), then Tobias's (Ch 10+); in Ch 8 to 9 Alexandra's Levin Sword, Theodora's Halberd and both casters

Healers: Sofia (Bishop, main), Theodora (Physic from Guardian, Ch 10), Ninae (Physic at White B), Bonaventure (Heal, Recover), Sirocco (Heal, Restore); Ultand's Patch Up heals the wall after each combat
Battalions: Theodora first, then Ultand (Cha 50), Ninae, Sirocco, Sofia, Bonaventure, then Tobias, Loretta, Lilian, Simon; Nydine and the fliers carry none
Hit: Bonaventure's Additional Intel next to Tobias, Battleblade Strike and Enrage on Tobias, Crescendo (Lilian, Lysander), Marksmanship (Lilian), Theodora's Rein
Res: Alexandra (Protecting Wings, Phantom Ring from Ch 9), Ninae's Spirits' Guidance on the wall, Sofia's Barrier on the mage side

Divine claims (one holder in the Part III army): Theodora The Trident, Tobias The Eternal, Troy The Godhand, Sirocco The Avatar, Nuzzuo The Calamity, Loretta The Blade; Cai The Cavalier, Leda The Apsara (D-131)

Part III imports stay open: decide after this Part II whether to skip Part II on Dietrich, Cai and Leda. The 15 stand alone; merges (Sirocco, Simon, Ultand, Ninae, Nydine, Noctula) are a bonus (D-130)
Paradise Fish ×2 from Lake Brontes (Saveilon): one pays Zarcone's Giant's Ring (Ch 6), one is Ninae's recruit item (6/1)
Part III undead: Cleansing Blades for Alexandra (Talimun's), Lysander (Part II Ch 2 drop) and Tobias (Theodora's Ch 6 copy); Ultand's Seraphim is the backup; the rest fight beside Eshmel
Ability slots: every class has 5, and every stage fills all 5 from level, mastery and skill-rank abilities (D-102)
Cursed treasures: open all 9 Part I cursed chests plus Noctula's Claw and hold them past 10/24; Theodora (Muen, then Vendetta), Orchel, Eshmel and Anatolia use them in Part III (D-103, D-104)

deployment.summary: Two groups built on stacked auras. The Fortress takes the enemy phase on a choke: Theodora (Guardian, Royal Resolve) with Ninae or Ultand adjacent, Bonaventure's Def +3 and Tobias on the next tile, Sofia's Physic and Sirocco's magic behind. The Strike group takes the player phase: Alexandra (Silver Maiden), Loretta, Lysander and Lilian end turns next to each other. Zarcone holds the Hammer in Ch 6 to 7; Tobias sits Ch 8 to 9 (dungeons, Arena) and returns with it in Ch 10. Nydine, Noctula, Simon and Nuzzuo level on the bench for Part II, which fields all 15.

roles.role: Lord, Fortress anchor, first battalion carrier
roles.why: Guardian (HP 80, Res 45 growth), Great Counter and Royal Resolve (half damage, 30%) hold chokes; best Cha and Authority for gambits.
Priest at Lv 20, Guardian at Lv 35. Ultand: Patch Up and Pray for Safety (Ddg +10) beside the wall, Cha 50. Ninae: Spirits' Guidance (Hit/Avo +10 vs magic) on mage maps.
S-rated healer: Magic Heal +10, Distant Healing range, Physic at White Magic B; Theodora casts Physic from Guardian (Ch 10), Ninae at White B.
Sage Advice (Def +3) and Additional Intel (Hit +10, +20 at Lv 35) on the adjacent tile; Cutting Gale for fliers; Heal, Recover and Torch.
S in both character lists; doubled Black Magic from Shaman, Ovate by Ch 12. Joins Ch 7; Jester's Levin Sword once Renown 9 lands (it hits with Mag).
Zarcone swings the Hammer in Ch 6 to 7; Tobias (Warrior) from Ch 10: Battleblade Strike (Dex +2 per combat) and Enrage fix his Hit. Simon carries the second Hammer in Part II.
Myrmidon at Lv 20, Shido at Lv 35, Sword boon and Spd 55: Steadfast (Avo +10 at half HP), Peak Form at full HP. Ends turns next to Alexandra.
The only archer in Part I: every bow is Effective+ vs fliers, Longbow Deadeye, Crescendo, Sniper's Marksmanship. Nuzzuo is the second bow in Part II.

roles.role: Lead flier, sword striker, Res dodge tank
roles.why: The player's carry for Parts II and III. Wing Soldier on Bucephalus from Ch 9 (Spd 80, Res 50 growth), Protecting Wings, Phantom Ring, Levin Sword; Silver Maiden beside the Strike group.
Armored Ornius Rider jumps walls until Lv 35, then Dragoon (carried in from Cai's path): Ji on armor and cavalry, Besieger.

roles.backup: Ultand, Ninae, Sirocco, Sofia, Bonaventure, then Tobias, Loretta, Lilian, Simon
roles.why: Infantry or armored only, tier at or below Authority. Ultand's Cha 50 makes her the best carrier after Theodora. Fewer slots? Drop Simon (bench), then Lilian, then Loretta.

phases.note: Theodora, Tobias and Bonaventure start alone; Lilian and Lysander join in Ch 4 and Sofia in Ch 5. Bonaventure heals until Sofia arrives; Novice Hunters (Ch 4) go on Theodora. Guests (Ch 3, 4, 5) may take slots.
Zarcone swings the Hammer from Ch 6 (seven deploy there); Sirocco joins in Ch 7 week 1 and takes slot 8. Loretta and Nydine join late Ch 7 and level in dungeons.

Alexandra and Loretta take Zarcone's and Tobias's seats. Ultand holds the wall seat, Ninae on mage maps. Tobias sits for dungeons and Arena seats. No Hammer: Levin Sword, Halberd and both casters break armor. Simon and Nuzzuo join 7/1.

Core 11 minus two per map: Ultand or Ninae (Ninae on mage maps), and Lilian or Bonaventure (Lilian in on flier and shield maps). Tobias returns with the Hammer. Ch 11: Res side left (Fire Orb), Fortress right (ballista). Diego joins Ch 12 for Part III only.

synergies.title: Fortress pocket
synergies.how: Theodora holds the choke on enemy phase. Ultand (or Ninae) ends adjacent: Patch Up heals her after every combat, Pray for Safety adds Ddg +10 from Lv 20; Ninae's Spirits' Guidance gives Hit/Avo +10 vs magic (within 2 at Lv 35). Bonaventure on another adjacent tile adds Def +3 (Sage Advice); Tobias holds the second tile. Sofia and Sirocco stay one row back.
synergies.payoff: Def +3, Ddg +10, Hit/Avo +10 vs magic and a heal after every combat; Royal Resolve halves 30% of hits

synergies.title: Silver Maiden strike pocket
synergies.how: Player phase: the Strike group attacks, then ends its turns around Alexandra so Silver Maiden counts each adjacent ally. Loretta stays at full HP for Peak Form: Sofia tops her up from range 3, Ultand's Patch Up when she ends next to the wall. Mage side from Ch 9: Alexandra baits (Res 50 growth, Protecting Wings, Phantom Ring).
synergies.payoff: Three allies adjacent: Hit/Avo +15 for Alexandra; Loretta at full HP: Atk +3 (Avo +10 more at Lv 35)

synergies.title: Choke and heal
synergies.how: Sofia stays two rows behind the Fortress and Physics whoever took the most hits. Once she masters Bishop (Ch 10 on), Barrier (Res +3) covers whoever stands next to her on mage maps.
synergies.payoff: Sofia's Physic heals 18 (8 +10) from range, so Theodora never steps off the choke

synergies.title: Healing Order
synergies.how: At Authority B Sofia learns Healing Order?: Healing Knowledge (+10 HP) spreads to every healer within 3 spaces. Keep the other healers within 3 of her when they heal.
synergies.payoff: Every healer within 3 of Sofia heals +10 HP?: each Physic goes from 8 to 18

synergies.title: Gambit line
synergies.how: Theodora (Lions of Megaira), Ultand, Sirocco (Shadow Mages) and Bonaventure (Elevated Priests) fight as one line: the walls in front, the casters one row back. Each gambit needs an exact spot relative to its target, so line them up on player phase before Theodora ends her turn on the choke.
synergies.payoff: Four area gambits from one formation in one player phase; [[stat:Cha]] raises gambit Hit (Ultand Cha 50)

synergies.title: Accuracy escort
synergies.how: Bonaventure moves first and ends next to the axe user about to attack: Additional Intel Hit +10 (30%, +20 at Lv 35). Tobias's arts and the Hit 60 Hammer (Zarcone in Ch 6 to 7, Tobias from Ch 10) need it most; Battleblade Strike stacks Dex +2 per combat on top. From Ch 9 he casts Swarm Z (Spd -3) on the target first.
synergies.payoff: Hit +10 at 30% (+20 at Lv 35) and Def +3 on the attacker: the Hit 60 Hammer and Tobias's arts start landing

synergies.title: Effectiveness coverage
synergies.how: Armor: the Hammer (Zarcone in Ch 6 to 7; Tobias from Ch 10, +2 at Ch 12), Alexandra's Levin Sword (+2 at Ch 12), Theodora's Halberd then Ji, both casters. Cavalry: Theodora's Ji, Lysander's Halberd and Ji, Nydine's Iron Spear. Fliers: Lilian's Da Mina Bow and Longbow, Bonaventure's Cutting Gale, Sirocco's magic.
synergies.payoff: Effective+ triples Mt: Hammer 14 → 42 vs armor; Ji doubles vs armor and cavalry

synergies.title: Deadeye sniper nest
synergies.how: Longbow Deadeye trades Hit for range 5 and triple damage: Crescendo stacks from her kills, and Bonaventure adjacent adds Additional Intel. They support each other; Lilian also supports Lysander, Tobias, Nydine and Simon.
synergies.payoff: Deadeye's Hit −30 at range 3–5: Additional Intel Hit +10 (30%) and Crescendo Hit +3 per kill buy it back

Theodora.role: Lord, Guardian tank, Physic, first battalion carrier
Theodora.why: Lord and the S-rated tank; best Cha and Authority on the team for gambits.
Theodora.partII: Stays Guardian through Part II: Physic and Brace on the chokes; Sentinel at Lv 45 in Part III.

Sofia.why: S-rated healer; Bishop is a top class, and Healing Order at Authority B boosts every other healer.
Sofia.partII: Stays Bishop: main Physic carrier, deploy every map.

Bonaventure.role: Support caster: Def and Hit aura, second healer, battalion carrier
Bonaventure.why: Joins Ch 1; once Sirocco arrives his best use is the Fortress tile next to Theodora or Tobias (Def +3, Hit +10), plus Heal, Recover, Torch and Cutting Gale.
Bonaventure.partII: Bishop in Ch 1 to 2 for Barrier, then Ovate from Ch 3; deploy every map.

Tobias.why: Ch 1 front-liner; sits Ch 8 to 9 (dungeons, Arena) and returns in Ch 10 as a Warrior with the refined Hammer. Battleblade Strike and Enrage fix his Hit.
Tobias.partII: Warrior through Part II with Da Mina Axe +2 and Hammer +2; stays Warrior to S3, The Eternal in S4 (Troy holds The Godhand).

Lilian.why: The only Part I archer: flier answer (every bow is Effective+) and Longbow Deadeye. Ch 10 to 12 she swaps with Bonaventure by map.
Lilian.partII: Stays Sniper; takes the Ch 5 Deadeye shield trick.

Lysander.why: Joins Ch 4; Dragoon carries in from Cai's path. Mounted, so no battalion.
Lysander.partII: Stays Dragoon; the Ch 2 southeast Ranger drops his Cleansing Blade +1.

Sirocco.role: Main black-magic nuke, second battalion carrier
Sirocco.why: S tier, joins Ch 7 and fills the empty second-caster role; Authority preferred and Cha 45 for gambits. Jester's Levin Sword once Renown 9 lands.
Sirocco.partII: Ovate in Ch 12 or once he hits Lv 35, all of Part II; The Avatar in S4. Barrier comes with the Leda merge if her army imports.

Alexandra.role: Lead flier, sword striker, Res dodge tank
Alexandra.why: Joins Ch 8 week 1 (Renown 6) at about Lv 15 and takes Zarcone's seat; Wing Soldier at Lv 20 in Ch 9. Built to carry Parts II and III.
Alexandra.partII: Stays Wing Soldier; Celestial Trooper at Lv 45 in Part III.

Zarcone.why: Joins Ch 6 with the Hammer for two maps; from Ch 8 Alexandra and Loretta take the seats and he goes to storage. The refined Hammer passes to Tobias in Ch 10.

Loretta.role: Strike dodger, sword (The Blade in Part III)
Loretta.why: Recruit late Ch 7 (Support 3, Renown 5, 3 Iron Swords) at about Lv 15; deploys from Ch 8. Myrmidon at Lv 20, Shido at Lv 35. Supports Tobias and Ultand.
Loretta.partII: Shido (Ch 12 or the Part II Ch 1 floor); Sword Master in S3 (Mars), The Blade in S4.

Ultand.role: Second wall: Patch Up, Pray for Safety, battalion carrier
Ultand.why: Recruit 6/1 (Support 3, Renown 6, short quest) at about Lv 15: Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 9), Guardian at Lv 35. Holds the wall seat; Cha 50 for gambits and Lust.
Ultand.partII: Guardian (Ch 12 if Lv 35, else Part II Ch 1); Sentinel in Part III; Seraphim C is the backup undead answer.

Ninae.role: Second wall on mage maps: Spirits' Guidance, Physic
Ninae.why: Recruit 6/1 (Support 3, Renown 6, 1 Paradise Fish) at about Lv 15: Priest at Lv 20 (Ch 9), Physic at White B. Takes the wall seat on mage maps.
Ninae.partII: Guardian on a Part II Ch 1 License; Sentinel in Part III; dark mages in Part III.

Nydine.why: Recruit late Ch 7 (Support 3, Renown 5, 3 Iron Axes) at about Lv 15: Armored Ornius Rider at Lv 20 (Ch 9). Stays [Cavalry] for Barge Through.
Nydine.partII: Cataphract at the Lv 35 floor (Ch 1 to 2); Great Knight in S3 (Credna).

Noctula.why: Recruit 6/1 (Renown 3): she joins a Pugilist with Ursa's Right Claw (player report ?). Levels on the bench; the Claw stays stored for Anatolia.
Noctula.partII: Pugilist through Part II (Onager bait); War Monk in S3 (Aurora: White D, Gauntlet B).

Simon.why: Recruit 7/1 (Support 3, Renown 7, coin flip Tails) at about Lv 15: Brigand at Lv 20 (Ch 10). Axe and Sword boons, Power Spike, Close Call. Supports Theodora, Lilian, Ninae.
Simon.partII: Warrior on a Part II Ch 1 License with the Nemea Cavern Hammer; Battlemaster from S2 to the end (Tobias holds The Eternal).

Nuzzuo.why: Recruit 7/1 (Renown 6, 3 Iron Bows) at about Lv 15, without a Levin Sword. Rogue at Lv 20 (Ch 10); Infantry seats for Sword and Bow.
Nuzzuo.partII: Ranger at the Ch 2 floor (Part II Ch 4 Dragoons), Sniper in Ch 5; Bow Knight S3, The Calamity S4.

Diego.why: Joins in Ch 12 after Orchel's Paralogue (Support 2, Renown 8). No Part I or II build: storage until Part III.

part2.note: Fifteen: the core 11 plus the bench 4 (Nydine, Noctula, Simon, Nuzzuo). Part II auto-levels anyone below its floor (Lv 33, then Army Training's 34, 35, 37, 39) on personal growths only, so the bench arrives at its Part I level in the Specialty it earned. Part II Licenses: Simon Warrior and Ninae Guardian in Ch 1 (Ultand, Loretta and Sirocco too if Ch 12 missed them), Nydine Cataphract and Nuzzuo Ranger at the Ch 2 floor. Whether battalions work in Part II is not documented: each unit keeps its Ch 12 squad ?. Rotation (D-131): caps are 10 in Ch 1 and 13 in Ch 2 to 6, and each bench unit plays at least 3 of the 6 maps; the War chapter plans say who sits where and why.

mechanics.what: Theodora recruits battalions at settlements (Recruit Soldiers: one random squad from the town pool after a few turns; Rousing Speech from Renown 5 strips low tiers). Only infantry or armored units carry one, tier at or below their Authority; the carrier gets flat stat bonuses and the gambit. No gambits in Clashes. Gambit numbers are not documented.
mechanics.impact: Carrier order: Theodora, Ultand (Cha 50), Ninae, Sirocco, Sofia, Bonaventure, then Tobias, Loretta, Lilian, Simon. Theodora Novice Hunters (Ch 4), Armored Sentinels (Ch 6), Lions of Megaira (B, Ch 10), Divine-Shield Guard (A?, Part III). Sirocco Mage Pupils (Ch 7) to Shadow Mages (B, Ch 12). Each build page names its squad. Nydine (Ornius), Alexandra and Lysander carry none. Recruit at Regia and Alecto (Ch 6), Raivo Port (Ch 7, 10), Megaira (Ch 9), Port of Pandora (Ch 10).

mechanics.what: Arena Heavy, Mage and Mounted Training all raise Authority. Tactics Manuals add Authority (inferred from the name): the Ch 7 Transfer Battalions tutorial, Nowah's Cave and Corroios Fort Ruins chests (Part I), item shops in Breston (x2), Regia, Callianeira Port and Grand Aragon, and 100 troop points from surplus battalions at the Transport Chief (community-reported). Renown 5, 7 and 9 raise battalion quality and how many deploy at once (unverified).
mechanics.impact: The carriers already sit in Heavy or Mage Training, so Authority to B comes free; Arena seats bench first. Every Tactics Manual goes to Theodora for A? (Divine-Shield Guard). Transfer every surplus roll and each replaced squad at the Transport Chief: 100 troop points = 1 Tactics Manual. Authority arts: Theodora's Frontline Gambit at S, Sofia's Healing Order at B, Tobias's Power-Arts Order at A.

mechanics.what: Each course runs once a week with 2 seats: Combat (Sword, Axe, Gauntlet), Infantry (Sword, Bow, Infantry), Heavy (Spear, Axe, Heavy, Authority), Mage (Black, White, Authority), Mounted (Spear, Rider, Flier, Authority). Every rank trains to B; Training Lv 2 at Renown 4, Lv 3 at Renown 7.
mechanics.impact: Pairs come from the builds: Field Kit > Arena. Arena seats go to the bench first (no battle EXP): Tobias in Ch 8 to 9, the sitting wall, Nydine, Noctula, Simon and Nuzzuo bank their Part II and III ranks; then exams due now. Each trainee sits with a higher-ranked partner (+12.5 EXP per half rank below, up to 2 ranks, at Arena Lv 3). Part II has no Arena.

mechanics.what: Each chapter's pair pays 5,500G and Renown; the Ch 8, 9 and 11 pairs unlock Cataphract, Guardian and Dragoon (sources conflict on one quest or both). All expire 10/24.
mechanics.impact: Guardian and Dragoon carry in from the earlier routes, so no exam waits on them. Cataphract (Ch 8) is Nydine's Lv 35 class in Part II. Do every pair for Renown: it feeds the battalion perks at 5, 7 and 9 and the Renown 8 gate for Advanced exams.

mechanics.what: From Ch 6 Theodora sails the Lir Sea; Enno Isle (Lv 24) and Northern Passage are hers alone in Part I, and Uncharted Isle (Lv 30) is open to her any time.
mechanics.impact: Enno Isle's Short Axe goes to Zarcone and its Healing Staff to Sofia; Northern Passage's Phantom Ring (Avo +5, after her Ch 9 story) goes to Alexandra in Ch 9; Southern Passage's Salamander (shared with Dietrich) goes to Bonaventure. Finish sea trips before lending Anatolia the ship in Ch 10.

mechanics.what: Theodora-only, Ch 10 or 11 only, costs many turns and holds no special items.
mechanics.impact: Skip it: those turns buy Arena weeks for the Authority and rank pushes and time for the Ch 11 paralogues.

mechanics.what: Played fourth, after Dietrich, Cai and Leda: Guardian, Ranger and Blacksmith carry in from Dietrich; Dragoon, Troubadour and Caladrius from Cai; Leda's run adds Troubadour and Ranger again. Dancer stays Leda's.
mechanics.impact: No Send Supplies quest gates an exam: Theodora takes Guardian in Ch 10, Lysander Dragoon in Ch 11, Nuzzuo Ranger in Part II. Cataphract unlocks in Ch 8 for Nydine (Part II). Theodora can't capture mounts in Part I, so mounted units run base class growths; only Alexandra brings one (Bucephalus).

mechanics.what: Recruits scale to the chapter: Ch 6 to 8 joins arrive at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class, Ch 9 joins at Lv 15 to 25 (open), Ch 10+ joins already Specialty at about Lv 25, Ch 11 to 12 joins can't be developed in Part I. Unrecruited units auto-level on personal growths only, and so does Part II's floor (Lv 33).
mechanics.impact: Loretta and Nydine join late Ch 7; Alexandra, Ultand, Ninae and Noctula on 6/1; Simon and Nuzzuo on 7/1. Loretta and Alexandra deploy at once, Ultand and Ninae share the wall seat; Nydine, Noctula, Simon and Nuzzuo level in dungeon parties and the Arena for Part II. Diego joins after Orchel's Paralogue in Ch 12 for Part III only. Keep Sunday meals going so each Support 3 lands on time, and pack every bench unit's Part II kit before Ch 12 ends.

mechanics.system: Side trips and free class switching
mechanics.what: Once certified, a unit switches between its classes for free (Proctor, Base Menu or Battle Prep). A sideways class costs one License and earns a mastery that stays equippable. Mastery pace is not documented.
mechanics.impact: Early joiners master their Specialty class long before Lv 35, so Ch 8 to 9 side trips use the wait: Tobias Brigand (on the bench), Lilian Rogue, Lysander Archer. Leave a side trip when its mastery shows; at Lv 35 take the Advanced class on time and finish the mastery in Part II. The Increase Class EXP boon from your Dietrich run speeds this up.

mechanics.what: Renown arrives later than older guides assume: plan with the Ledger's Renown pace. Send Supplies quests are this route's Renown quests, and generic subquests you cleared on Cai's route complete themselves here.
mechanics.impact: Hand in each Send Supplies quest the chapter it appears. Take every god audience (about 50, no Turn) when a temple shows gold on the map. Run every Paralogue (150 each); behind in Ch 8, pick For the Empire's Safety for 200 Renown at once.

mechanics.what: An Archive is used up when read: the spell stays on that unit for good and takes no slot. One copy of each per route. Dark spells weigh 20 to 23 (Mire 15, Death 13), so nobody doubles with them.
mechanics.impact: Bonaventure reads Z (Swarm Z: Spd -3 at range 2, Ch 9), T (Dark Spikes Τ?: 60 Mt vs cavalry) and θ (Banshee Θ: immobilize at range 3; Iapetus Cavern, Lv 32, Ch 11). Sirocco reads Γ (Death Γ: Mt 15, Crit 20) if Vandahl lists it. Sirocco reads L (Luna Λ: ignores Res; Aditi's Cave, Lv 28). Nobody reads B (Mire Β, Cave Behind the Falls, Lv 22).

mechanics.what: Meals, gifts, the Theater and the Thermae are weekly slots, not Turns. Quests finished on an earlier route complete themselves, so most free times end with Turns to spare. Dungeon enemies return every chapter; chests open once.
mechanics.impact: Sunday: give this week's gifts, then hold all 3 meals at half price (Theodora + 2 targets). Spare Turns, in order: gather the next Vandahl barter materials, run the chapter's dungeon with this week's meal pairs (link attacks raise Support), then hand the rest to Inn Auto-Activities.
